notes.title: Upcoming Update: Catamyst 1.1
notes.content: [p][i]Just popping in to quickly tell you about the next Catamyst update...[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]v1.1: Part One[/h3][p]I wanted to let y'all know what's going on with the 1.1 update. Since announcing the update, I've started full time work and so my time to work on the game has been limited. [/p][p]Rather than just let the updates that ARE done go to waste, I thought it'd be better to finish up what I'm doing and then push it out as [b]part one[/b]. [/p][p]I'm still working on some finishing bits, and then testing, but it should be ready to go relatively soon. I won't promise a release date as I don't want to overpromise.[/p][p][/p][h3]What's in Part One?[/h3][p]Here's a brief overview of what's included in the next game update:[/p][p][b]Reworks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Status Effect system overhaul, including stackable buffs, potion-specific effects and more.[/p][/*][*][p]New Ward shielding system (+ upgrades), replacing Overheal and Damage Reduction.[/p][/*][*][p]"Imbued" upgrade overhaul (new  and better effects!).[/p][/*][*][p]Catalysts now have a random rarity (rather than predetermined) to make decision making harder on you.[/p][/*][*][p]UI redesign (a new main menu!) + additional animations.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Stuff[/b][/p][list][*][p]4 new powerful Catalysts.[/p][/*][*][p]2 new Potion types.[/p][/*][*][p]2 new Status Effects that come with the new potions.[/p][/*][*][p]Custom difficulty options - choose from difficulty 1-5, where 3 is the current game's difficulty.[/p][/*][/list][p]Plus your usual suite of balance changes and bug fixes![/p][p][/p][h3]What about the other stuff?[/h3][p]Rather than a big "Part Two", I'm more interested in smaller regular updates. I'm thinking a couple upgrades here or new enemy there. Bigger updates will come individually, rather than a big grand update.[/p][p]This works with my schedule and means content should come out a lot faster. Everything in the previous update post is still planned![/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, that's all I've got for now, thanks for playing Catamyst :D[/p][p]~ [url="https://bsky.app/profile/bugsaretasty.dev"]bugsaretasty[/url] (follow me on bsky!)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: [Newspost] Catamyst - What's Next?
notes.content:
Long time no see! [i](like... 7 months.. oops)[/i]

We're almost coming up to Catamyst's one year anniversary so it's time to announce some updates for the game. 

You may know that I've been working on my final year of university, and I'm glad to say we're all done with that! This frees up a lot of time and creative energy to get back to work on Catamyst. 

[h1]Patches and Fixes[/h1]
In the coming week or so, I'll be updating the game with some much needed bug fixes. This includes a major crash from failing a run that seems to pop up frequently! 
Thanks for all your bug reports and feedback <3

[h1]Catamyst: Version 1.1[/h1]
If you've been keeping up with my [url=https://twitch.tv/bugsaretasty/]Twitch streams[/url], you'll know that [b]Catamyst v1.1 development is now underway[/b]! 

The working title for this update is: [b]Catamyst 1.1: Awakening[/b]!

Here's a breakdown of what's coming with the update:
[list]
[*]A brand new final boss encounter, designed to test your skills and progress the game's story!
[*]New enemies to defeat, including both standard and minibosses.
[*]A bumper pack of new content, such as potions, catalysts and enchantments.
[*]Overhauling underperforming systems of the game to bring it up to a higher quality.
[*]Balancing and Bug Fixes galore!
[*]...much more to come!
[/list]
[[i]Please note: this update is a work-in-progress and subject to change[/i]]

Catamyst celebrates its first year of existence in August, and I can't think of a better time to release this update. I'm not announcing a specific release date yet, but you'll know sooner to August.

[h1]Other News...[/h1]

I've got nothing concrete to announce here, but there's a lot of Catamyst-related content in the works. The world of Catamyst is expansive and I've got a lot of exciting stories I want to tell with Willow. We're early days on these projects, but I promise this game and franchise has a really exciting future! v1.1 isn't the end for Catamyst, that's for sure.

I'd recommend keeping an eye on my [url=https://bsky.app/profile/bugsaretasty.dev]Bluesky[/url] account to find out the latest for all things Catamyst. 

For now, that's all I wanted to share. I appreciate it's been a while, but we're finally barc to business.
I'll leave you with a concept drawing for an announced Catamyst project!

See you later!
-[b] bugsaretasty[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Catamyst v1.03/1.04 (25/10/23)
notes.content:
[h3]v1.03 - Happy (nearly) Halloween! [/h3]

Here's a few bug fixes to keep the game running smoothly. More to come soon!
This patch is primarily to handle a major bug with the "Artifact Ban" hex.

In other news, we're now posting on Bluesky! Check out the links below:
[url=https://bsky.app/profile/bugsaretasty.bsky.social]@bugsaretasty[/url]
[url=https://bsky.app/profile/cochu.bsky.social]@Cochu[/url]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] “Artifact Ban” hex is no longer offered as a temporary measure.
[*] “Spirit Shield” artifact now shows the correct icon when unlocked.
[*] Best Time is now only updated when you complete a run.[/list]

[h3]v1.04 - Bonus Patches [/h3]

Just a few more patches I managed to get out today.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in the Journal where an enchantment icon was not loading correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue in the Journal where the map icon was not loading correctly.
[*] Prevented the Run Timer from continuing after the run is completed.
[*] Corrected numerous text issues.
[*] Removed some references to non-Grove maps.
[*] Fixed an issue where Mycellius Prime wasn’t correctly following its attack pattern.
[*] Firefly of Warding no longer bypasses knockback immunity.
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed “Master of Attunement” Vis cost reduction from 25%->15%.
[*] Increased the max damage increase from “Luck of the Grove” from 15%->25%.
[/list]
Thanks!
- bugsaretasty

notes.title: Catamyst - Release Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44995254/ad0a14c04c31f1ba26b3053a588c4817dfedff70.png[/img]

The time has finally come to enter the Firefly Grove and take on the Obelisk!

Catamyst is now available to purchase and play! After months of hard work, it's finally ready to play.

Throughout the next week, we'll be keeping an eye on how things go and keep up to date on patches/fixes for you all. Soon we'll post a "Patch/Known Issue Thread" once players start to dig into the game a bit more.

Beyond that, the Catamyst OST is available to stream online!
Here's the links to find it:[list]
[*] [url=https://cochu.bandcamp.com/album/catamyst-soundtrack]Purchase on Bandcamp[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAhOKAdSW3nLCXoEMrHDJI6ZlwRzsxZvB]Stream on YouTube[/url]
[*] Stream on Spotify (Coming Soon)[/list]
This isn't the end for Catamyst though - we'll be showing a roadmap of future updates in the coming weeks, including plans for DLC and free updates.

In the meantime, check out the Catamyst Trailer [url=https://youtu.be/sSpI9FBBdVk?si=geSKOqdyCK086a-U]here[/url].

Thanks for playing Catamyst!
We're so excited for everyone to enjoy their time in the Firefly Grove. 

Good luck with your expeditions, rangers!

- [url=https://x.com/bugsaretasty]Winter[/url] & [url=https://x.com/CochuU_]Cochu[/url]
